general_rules.scope_precondition: A material claim role is surface-eligible only when every mandatory scope binding is present in its semantic paragraph context.
general_rules.criterion_subject_binding: For an acceptance-criterion role, the grammatical semantic subject is criterion_fact_ids; class, age and specimen are context fields and cannot become the criterion subject.
general_rules.case_scope_completeness: A case-specific role is plan-valid only when all mandatory case_ids declared by its condition set are present.
general_rules.no_surface_in_this_phase: This contract records semantic fields and eligibility only. It performs no rendering and emits no prose.
general_rules.source_term_ownership: Named source cases remain exact source labels until a later versioned surface contract supplies claim-owned Turkish terms; generic glosses are not widened.

entries.meaning: The 22.5 MPa individual minimum and 25.5 MPa three-sample average minimum are acceptance criteria used to decide acceptable strength for C25/30; the class designation is not itself a criterion.
